QuestInfo.fullDiz: The town %1n asks you to accompany the caravan up to %2n and offered to pay %3d.
An inhabitant of %1n asked me to defend the transport on its way to %2n and offered to pay %3d.
%1n demands me to accompany the transport carrying an important cargo to %2n. If it arrives safely, I will get %3d.
The transport from %1n goes to %2n. Some bandits often ambush traders coming that way, so I agreed to protect it for a mere %3d.
The town %1n asks you to destroy the enemy for a reward of %3d coins.
The citizens of %1n are often being attacked by the cunning brigand who always escapes punishment. I agreed to get rid of him for %3d.
I will get %3d, when I get rid of an outlaw that threatens %1n.
The town %1n will pay %3d coins for each enemy killed.
The bandits have lost all shame! We must teach them a good lesson. The people of %1n will pay %3d for every killed enemy.
The authorities of %1n began to fight for the safety of the trade routes. I will be paid %3d for every hostile vehicle slain.
For a modest percentage of my money, the faction %2b is willing to make peace with me.
The town %1n asked me to deliver package to %2n. Upon arrival, I will receive %3d.
I’ll get %3d, when I deliver the package to %2n. Somebody is waiting for it, but I am not going to hurry for such a modest reward.
Some crank from %1n is will to pay me %3d, if I go and say hello to his friend living in %2n.
To atone for my past misdeeds and become free, I must protect Ieri! He alone saw the sensitive soul within me.
Truly powerful guns aren’t sold in stores – I heard there’s some good loot at the abandoned warehouse.

QuestInfo.briefDiz: Earn Money and Buy a New Car

QuestInfo.fullDiz: To regain the clan’s respect, I must outdo everyone and deal with Ieri alone.
The order I accidentally saw mentioned the Ghost Town. It’s worth starting my search there.

QuestInfo.briefDiz: Catch Up with Ieri Beyond the Swamp
QuestInfo.fullDiz: The cunning old man tricked me, but now I know exactly where to find him.

QuestInfo.briefDiz: Return to the Old Man’s Village
QuestInfo.fullDiz: It’s time to talk to the old man who saved me again. I have a few questions for him about my mission.
I need to help investigate the events that occurred in the Ghost Town. Ieri is clearly behind them; once I figure everything out, I’ll be on his trail.

I need to help investigate the events that occurred in the Ghost Town. Ieri is clearly behind them; once I figure everything out, I’ll be on his trail. The witness’s testimony didn’t give me any leads. I need to find someone who knows at least something.
Without a car and weapons, it’ll be hard to complete the mission: first I’ll arm myself, gathering information about Ieri along the way.
Some guy asked me to help kill the bandits who’ve settled near Calis.

QuestInfo.briefDiz: Find the Magnetic Accelerator and Bring It to Andries
QuestInfo.fullDiz: A mechanic named Andries asked me to find and bring him a magnetic accelerator.
